title: 30 Days to Build a Game with AI (From 0 to Steam - part 10)
author: Initial_Spend8988
selftext:
It’s been a bit slower the past few days, had to step away for “life stuff”,  but I’m back and making progress again! The exchange station is now live, and the game can finally display and convert collected resources.

At first, I thought it’d be a quick feature… but once I sat down to implement it, I realized I had to define **how much each material is worth**, the units used, and more importantly, what happens when you combine them for upgrades. It became a mini economy design session, which took more time than I planned for. But it was worth it, now the foundation is in place for crafting systems down the line.

Right now, the player can:

* See collected resources in the exchange station
* Convert those materials into rarer materials to upgrade parts
* View dynamic values (based on the material type)
* Track material totals in the HUD (though it's still rough and needs polish)

**Next up**:

* Improving the UI and HUD — making sure the resource display is clearer
